purpose: Evaluate payment risk classification consistency, warning detection, and recommended actions.

scenarios.description: Verified supplier with matching purchase order
scenarios.warning_details: A detailed invoice is available. The recipient is verified, bank details are verified, the amount matches the purchase order, and there is no unusual payment pressure.

scenarios.description: Established supplier with an incomplete invoice
scenarios.warning_details: The invoice is missing a detailed breakdown of services. The supplier is established, the amount matches the purchase order, and there is no unusual urgency or bank-detail change.
required_behaviors: Considers the established supplier and matching purchase order
Avoids assigning HIGH risk without sufficient justification

scenarios.description: Unverified bank-account change with payment pressure
scenarios.warning_details: The recipient has emailed new bank account details. The new details differ from those on the previously verified invoice and have not been independently verified. The sender demands immediate payment.

scenarios.description: Unknown recipient, incomplete invoice, and urgent payment
scenarios.warning_details: The invoice lacks sufficient detail, the recipient is unknown, and the sender demands immediate payment without proper documentation.
required_behaviors: Identifies the missing recipient and invoice information
Does not claim fraud is confirmed

scenarios.description: Unknown recipient with missing contact information but no additional warning signs
scenarios.warning_details: The recipient's legal business name and contact information are unavailable. The invoice description is clear. There is no reported payment pressure, bank-detail change, unusual urgency, or other suspicious activity.
expected_warning_signs: Missing recipient business and contact information
required_behaviors: Accounts for the absence of additional warning signs

scenarios.description: Unverified bank-account change, immediate payment demand, and discouraged verification
scenarios.warning_details: The recipient requests payment to a new bank account that differs from the previously verified invoice. The recipient demands immediate payment and discourages independent verification.
required_behaviors: Explains why the transaction is suspicious
Recommends stopping payment until independent verification
Distinguishes suspicious circumstances from confirmed fraud
